about: Second pass, 2026-10-10. The first pass of beds came out as near-silence (the prompts said 'room tone', 'soft', 'faint', 'quiet': ElevenLabs gave exactly that, 13 of 14 beds mastered 14 to 38 LU under target and failed). These prompts name a present, continuous SOUND SOURCE at a constant level, with body between 300 Hz and 3 kHz so a phone speaker plays it. Same keys; takes continue from take 4.

beds.prompt: Constant loud trickling and dripping of water all around inside a huge flooded stone cistern: hundreds of drips and thin streams falling into shallow water without pause, bright and wet, with a long cathedral echo. Full, present, steady level from start to end. No waves, no lapping, no splashes, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud continuous roar of industrial ventilation in an enormous concrete hall: a deep steady rumble with a strong hollow mid-range wind howl through giant columns and a constant airy rush on top. Full, present, constant level, huge reverb. No water, no voices, no music, no swells. Seamless loop.

Constant bright resonant whistle of air moving up a tall tiled stairwell shaft, like a steady tone blown across a bottle, with a small continuous trickle of water echoing below. Clear, present, glassy, steady level from start to end. No swells, no waves, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud continuous fountain water pouring into a pool inside a huge stone dome, heard as a full reverberant wash, with a steady warm metallic drone like a large singing bowl ringing underneath. Rich, present, constant level, long round echo. No waves, no voices, no choir, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud steady hum and airy rush of a large air handling unit in an empty indoor swimming hall, with a constant fluttering rumble of a fabric roof in wind above. Full, present, wide and bright, constant level from start to end. No splashing, no waves, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

Constant electrical buzz and hum of hundreds of small lamps in a tall dry hotel atrium, a steady mains hum with a clear buzzing edge, and a continuous air-conditioning whoosh from above. Full, present, dry, constant level. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Seamless loop.

Steady strong desert wind blowing over sand and around a small building: a constant full whoosh with a clear whistling tone through a gap. Present, dry, wide open air, constant level from start to end with no gusts. No birds, no insects, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud buzzing fluorescent tube lights and a whirring extractor fan in a narrow tiled stairwell: a steady electrical buzz with a clear harsh edge over a constant fan whirr. Close, boxy, present, constant level. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud continuous rush of water inside big iron pipes in a concrete boiler room, with a steady roaring boiler burner and a ringing metallic resonance. Full, close, present, constant level from start to end. No drips, no bangs, no voices, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud steady drone of air blowing through a metal ventilation duct in a low stone corridor: a full tonal whoosh with a slow wobbling beat and a rattling grille. Close, present, constant level. No drips, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud steady hum of an old electric motor behind a wooden wall, like an old refrigerator compressor, with a constant faint rattle of a loose metal plate and a ticking wall clock. Close, warm, present, constant level. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud steady electrical transformer hum in a long narrow corridor, a strong mains buzz with a clear nasal edge, and a constant whir of small ventilation fans behind many doors. Close, dry, present, constant level. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Seamless loop.

Loud constant rush of air and a thin stream of water running down the inside of a big fibreglass water slide tube: a full hollow plastic roar with a steady hiss of water on plastic. Present, close, constant level from start to end. No voices, no screams, no music. Seamless loop.

loops.prompt: A big water pump impeller churning in a concrete basin, close: a loud rhythmic slosh and gulp of water on every blade pass, about one per second, with a clear whirring motor whine and a rattling steel grating. Full, present, mechanical, constant level. No voices, no music. Seamless loop.

shots.prompt: Three loud clear metallic ticks of a brass ventilation grille cooling down, one after another, each a bright sharp tick with a short ringing echo under a stone dome. Close and present. No voices, no music.

One loud heavy drop of water plunging into a deep pool at the bottom of a tall tiled shaft: a full round plunk with a clear splash ring and a long echo climbing up the shaft. Close and present. No voices, no music.
Two loud slow wet bare footsteps slapping on tile in a tall tiled stairwell, one after another, each with a clear echo, then silence. Present and distinct. No voices, no breathing, no music.
A light bulb fizzes loudly for a second with a sharp electrical crackle and then bursts with one clear glassy pop. Close, dry and present. No voices, no music.
Two loud slow knocks on a heavy wooden door, knuckles on wood, each a full hollow knock with a dry echo in a tall empty hall. Present and distinct, then silence. No voices, no footsteps, no music.

A metal door handle is pushed down firmly and released: a loud clear squeak, a hard click of the latch and the spring snapping back, on a wooden door in a quiet corridor. Close and present. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
